quest.title: Early Learning Mechanism
quest.description: Faruzan decides to come to the aid of Acara Crafts for the sake of the children and the Akademiya's future...

talks.objective: Go to Port Ormos and look for Anis
Go to Port Ormos and look for Anis
Talk to the staff at Acara Crafts

dialogues.speaker: Mamdouh
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you came too? It's been a while?

dialogues.speaker: Anis
dialogues.text: Mamdouh, the one I recommended is here!

dialogues.speaker: Mamdouh
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're... uh, Madam Faruzan?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Try to keep it simple and fun?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Try to be accurate and detailed?

dialogues.speaker: Nadwah
dialogues.text: Archon be praised, I can finally send a report to my superiors! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Nadwah
dialogues.text: I have no idea how we might have persuaded her otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Anis
dialogues.text: Is Madam Faruzan really going to mentor me? What an honor!

dialogues.speaker: Anis
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sure she'll say "helping with illustrations isn't mentoring"... So, ah, don't tell her I said that.

dialogues.speaker: Mamdouh
dialogues.text: No wonder she's so well-respected at the Akademiya. When I first saw her, I thought she might be unreliable because she's so young...

dialogues.speaker: Mamdouh
dialogues.text: Ah! Don't let her know I said that. Anis warned me about that before...

dialogues.speaker: Qasit
dialogues.text: We need to wait two whole days before we get the new toys...

dialogues.speaker: Ruhi
dialogues.text: It might just be all reference stuff. It'll be a loooong time before we can play with the real toys.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Guess all we can do is play Genius Invokation TCG in the meantime...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Have you met with Madam Faruzan yet?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: It's fine. Collei has already filled me in, more or less.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I've also managed to settle some of the problems on my side, so I've got time to wait for Madam Faruzan to arrive.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Can you help me find out how she's faring in two days' time?

choices.text: She needs about two more days...
